app.name: Notion
app.managed_alternative_note: Composio provides managed Notion integration handling multi-workspace token exchange, page permission scopes, and token refresh automatically.
when_to_byoc: Custom branding: Display your own application name and logo on Notion's authorization page
Dedicated workspace rate limits: Separate your traffic from shared multi-tenant limits (3 req/sec per integration)
Internal integration tokens: Single-workspace direct internal integrations using secret tokens

summary: Dual-mode setup: Internal integrations are instant via API token. Public multi-workspace OAuth is self-serve without review; gallery listing is optional.
difficulty_factors: +15 pts: Public OAuth requires switching integration mode and configuring HTTPS redirects
+10 pts: Page-level permission model requires explicit workspace page sharing or grant selection
+0 pts: No review required for public OAuth link distribution (Gallery review is optional)

time_estimate.dev_wait_claim: Instant (0 seconds for internal and direct OAuth distribution)
time_estimate.production_wait_claim: 2–4 weeks only if submitting to public Notion Integrations Gallery
time_estimate.approval_wait: Instant for direct OAuth; 2–4 weeks for public Gallery

prerequisites: Notion workspace with admin permissions or permissions to create integrations
Public HTTPS redirect URI (HTTP allowed only for localhost)
Privacy Policy and Terms URL if enabling Public OAuth distribution

path.detail: Go to 'My Integrations' -> Click '+ New integration'. Select associated workspace, assign an App Name, and upload an icon.
By default, integrations are Internal (scoped to your workspace via secret token). In Distribution tab, toggle 'Make integration public' to enable OAuth 2.0 for external users.

path.action: Configure OAuth Redirect URI and Company Info
path.detail: Provide your HTTPS callback URI, Company Name, Website, and Privacy Policy link. Notion generates OAuth Client ID and Client Secret.
Under Capabilities, toggle: 'Read content', 'Update content', 'Insert content', and 'Read user information without email addresses'.

path.action: Implement OAuth Authorization URL & Token Exchange
path.detail: Direct users to https://api.notion.com/v1/oauth/authorize with client_id, response_type=code, and redirect_uri. Exchange code with HTTP Basic Auth (Client ID + Secret).

scopes.unlocks: Read page properties, blocks, and database contents
Modify existing pages, block text, and update database entries
Create new sub-pages, database entries, and blocks
Read names and profile photos of workspace members

approval.what_reviewed: Public OAuth direct links work without any review. Review is required ONLY if submitting to the Notion Integrations Gallery (which provides marketplace discoverability).
typical_rejection_reasons: Gallery submissions: Insufficient documentation or unclear onboarding for non-technical users
Failure to explain why the integration requires full content read/write capabilities
what_to_prepare: Public privacy policy and terms of service
Clear explanation of why workspace access is requested

blockers_and_fixes.symptom: object_not_found error (HTTP 404) when querying a page or database that definitely exists
blockers_and_fixes.cause: The Notion integration has not been granted access to that specific page or parent database. Notion's permission model requires explicit page grants.
blockers_and_fixes.fix: Instruct the user: In Notion, open the target page/database -> click '...' (top right) -> Connections -> Connect to [Your App Name].
blockers_and_fixes.escalation_template: N/A - Page sharing is handled within the user's Notion workspace UI.

blockers_and_fixes.cause: The authorization code was already consumed (one-time use) or expired, or redirect_uri mismatch occurred.
blockers_and_fixes.fix: Ensure redirect_uri in the POST /v1/oauth/token body matches the authorize request exactly, and perform token exchange immediately.

agent_can_do: Generate OAuth HTTP Basic authentication exchange code
Parse and traverse Notion block trees and nested database schemas
Handle Notion rate limiting (average 3 requests per second per token)
you_must_do: Switch integration to 'Public' if distributing to external teams
Advise end users to share specific workspace pages with your integration connection
agent_vs_human.handoff_critical_point: Human must create the integration at notion.so/my-integrations and toggle to Public if serving multi-tenant users.

what_to_do_next: Decide whether your agent needs Internal (single workspace) or Public (multi-tenant) access.
Add the client secret to your agent and test token exchange.

evidence.claim: Internal integrations provide instant access via secret token without an OAuth exchange flow
evidence.snippet: Internal integrations are private to your workspace. An internal integration generates an Internal Integration Secret you can immediately use in the Authorization header.

evidence.claim: Public integrations enable OAuth 2.0 and do not require Notion review for direct link distribution
evidence.snippet: Public integrations allow any Notion user to connect their workspace via OAuth 2.0. Direct link distribution does not require prior approval from Notion.

uncertainties: Notion does not support PKCE for OAuth 2.0; client credentials must be exchanged securely on a backend server.
